segments.name: crypto mining solutions
segments.description: Designs and sells ASIC-based Bitcoin mining machines and chips, including Avalon Home devices, to industrial and home miners.
segments.evidence: We primarily dedicated technology and expertise in ASIC applications to industrial Bitcoin mining machines and are a leading producer of Bitcoin mining machines in the global market.

revenueModel.text: Customers worldwide pay for Bitcoin mining machines and ASIC products, and the company also earns revenue from its own Bitcoin mining business.
revenueModel.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025, we generated revenue of US$34.0 million, US$44.0 million and US$113.2 million from the Bitcoin mining business, respectively.

changes.text: In 2025 the company decided to dispose of property and equipment related to its edge computing application business.
changes.evidence: In 2025, the Company determined to dispose property and equipment related to edge computing application.
